title: Bind one layout revision through calibration
description: Carry one exact immutable sheet-layout revision and canonical fingerprint through draft identity, calibration scene metadata, artifact metadata, observations, diagnostics, and future compatibility references.
acceptanceCriteria: A draft selects exactly one immutable layout identity, revision, and canonical fingerprint
Scenes, artifacts, observations, and diagnostics repeat or reference that exact binding
Any mismatched layout identity, revision, or fingerprint is refused before persistence or generation
No workflow action silently upgrades a draft to a newer layout revision

steps.details: Create one serializable calibration layout binding from the established immutable revision identity and canonical geometry fingerprint.
Require the binding in draft, scene, artifact, observation, diagnostic, and compatibility-facing metadata contracts.
Add one pure validator that returns structured reasons for identity, revision, or fingerprint mismatch.
Verify exact propagation, round trip, mismatch refusal, and immunity to creation of a newer layout revision.

technicalNotes: Maximum execution scope is ten minutes; reuse canonical fingerprint and immutable revision contracts.
A geometry fingerprint proves software identity only, not physical placement.
